html:
The North Island of Phu Quoc is known for its untouched nature, national park, peaceful beaches, and authentic local villages. A one day private car tour from the Centre Hotel Area to North Island is an ideal choice for travelers who prefer nature, fresh air, and a relaxed pace.

With Vietlook Travel, this private car service allows you to explore the northern part of Phu Quoc comfortably, without fixed schedules or crowded group tours.

Centre Hotel Area to North Island Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area to North Island attractions is approximately thirty five to fifty kilometers, depending on your selected route.

Driving time usually ranges from one and a half to two hours one way, excluding sightseeing stops. A private car gives you the freedom to stop anywhere along the way for photos, rest, or local experiences.

Suggested North Island Attractions

On a one day private car tour, you may visit:

  • Phu Quoc National Park

  • Ganh Dau Cape

  • Rach Vem fishing village and Starfish Beach

  • Cua Can River

  • Pepper farms and local villages

You can customize the itinerary based on your interests and travel pace.

Flexible One Day Private Car Service

This private car service offers:

  • Door-to-door pick up from Centre Hotel Area

  • Fully flexible itinerary and schedule

  • Private vehicle for your group only

  • No pressure from fixed tour timelines

  • Comfortable travel with air conditioning

Our local driver is happy to assist and recommend suitable stops during the journey.

Professional Driver and Vehicle Options

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced drivers familiar with North Island routes

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Smooth and safe driving

  • Baby seat available upon request

Available vehicle types include five seat cars, seven seat cars, sixteen seat minibuses, and luxury Carnival vehicles.
